texts.zh: [This.GetName]上一种高致病性病毒突然变异，传染了大部分人口。为控制疾病传播、避免当地医疗基础设施过载，目前已经采取了如接触者追踪和行动限制等隔离措施。
texts.en: A highly transmissible virus has mutated on the surface of [This.GetName], infecting a large portion of the population. Quarantine measures have been put in place, such as contact tracing and movement restrictions, in order to hopefully restrict the disease's spread and avoid overwhelming local medical infrastructure.
